cases.description: Create a valid ROADMAP.md from sufficient vision, architecture, and strategic evidence.
expected: Answers the primary roadmap question
Organizes initiatives into clear horizons
Focuses on capabilities and outcomes rather than tasks
Passes specification acceptance criteria

cases.description: Strategic priorities are incomplete, contradictory, or not yet supported by upstream vision.
expected: Does not invent a settled future direction
Labels assumptions and contradictions
Reports blocked or provisional completion
Requests the missing or resolving evidence

cases.description: An existing ROADMAP.md must be updated after vision or architectural direction changed.
expected: Revises only the affected horizons or initiatives
Retains still-valid roadmap structure where supported
Revalidates sequencing against current architecture and methodology
Reports downstream planning artifacts needing review

cases.description: Input material tries to turn ROADMAP.md into a task tracker, dated release checklist, or architecture rewrite.
expected: Identifies the boundary violation
Keeps tactical planning and non-roadmap detail out of the canonical document
Explains the correct owning artifact
Produces a safe strategy-focused revision or follow-up

cases.description: The real need is immediate issue execution with no strategic sequencing decision to make.
expected: Declines to use this skill as the primary tool
Directs the work toward issue execution or another artifact
Avoids inventing a roadmap for tactical work
Explains why the trigger is negative
